records.title: IIRIS Mourns the Passing of Veteran Strategic Affairs Expert Maroof Raza
records.summary: IIRIS Consulting expressed profound sorrow at the passing of Maroof Raza, a distinguished strategic affairs expert and national voice on defense and security issues.

records.title: IIRIS Launches IntelliTracker to Strengthen Police Case Monitoring and RBI Reporting for BFSI Sector
records.summary: IIRIS launched IntelliTracker, a purpose-built monitoring platform designed to support fraud-case visibility and RBI FMR 1-4 aligned reporting readiness for financial institutions.

records.title: IIRIS Signs MoU with NLU, Jodhpur to Form IIRIS Chair of Infosec and Forensic Society
records.summary: IIRIS formalized an academic collaboration with National Law University, Jodhpur to establish a center of excellence focused on information security and forensic science.
